tagline: how attention stopped writing down the thing it was computing
source: Mechanism and figures as published in the FlashAttention papers. Nothing on this page was measured here.

panels.title: The N x N matrix that never exists
panels.sub: K and V blocks on the outside, Q blocks on the inside, and a tile of the attention matrix that is formed on-chip and thrown away
panels.note: the softmax is rescaled as it goes, so a tile can be finished and discarded before the next one is read
panels.s: S = Q K^T, N x N - formed a tile at a time, never written to HBM
panels.discard: S_ij is discarded here - it is the only place the N x N matrix ever exists

panels.title: The ladder the whole idea stands on
panels.sub: attention was never short of arithmetic; it was short of bandwidth
panels.note: an algorithm that is aware of this ladder beats one that is not, at identical FLOPs
panels.cite: FlashAttention - Dao et al., NeurIPS 2022, Fig. 1
panels.tail: so the work worth removing is the traffic, not the arithmetic

panels.title: What it came to
panels.sub: the same numerics and the same outputs - everything gained was something that never moved
panels.note: attention that reaches GEMM-like utilisation, on the same silicon

meters.label: share of the GPU's peak FLOPs/s that attention reaches, A100
meters.note: 25-40% for FlashAttention, 50-73% for FlashAttention-2, both as published

chart.axis: end-to-end, relative to the baseline each was measured against

bars.label: the baseline each was measured against
